strategyReview: The system is currently carried by weekend Hyperliquid funding reversion: 299/428 live wins (69.9%) and 188/253 shadow wins, and by strict upside-barrier one-touch NO fade with edge gating (51/82 shadow wins, +5.75%). The main failures are concentrated in gold/PM-richness fades, broad one-touch edge shadows, PM proxy shorts, and cross-asset HYPE/BTC confirmation longs; these are producing near-zero to negative win rates and frequent losses against the underlying trend. Generic funding-extreme long and LLM/deep PM proxy variants also remain negative or breakeven and should not be expanded without stronger filters.

failureClusters.theme: Gold upside NO/premium fade against trend
failureClusters.evidence: Multiple gold rich-NO/heatmap/near-expiry short families are failing: find_0036 0/15 scorable wins, H-534 0/20, H-532 0/15, and gold PM-premium spread family 2/17. Loss examples repeatedly show gold rallying after entry (+5.37%, +3.97%, +6.71%, +8.74%, +7.35%).
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not fade rich GOLD upside NO, no-bias gap, or PM settlement premium without a confirmed spot downtrend filter. Kill or quarantine these variants until a trend-aligned refinement proves itself in shadow.

failureClusters.theme: Cross-asset HYPE/BTC confirmation longs at local tops
failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion has only 6/21 scorable wins (29%). Losses show BTC falling -1.69%, -2.93%, and -3.47% while HYPE above-SMA/stable-OI risk-on conditions were still true.
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not rely on HYPE spot/OI as confirmation for BTC continuation. Require BTC's own positive 24h momentum, or kill the family after the current tests resolve.

failureClusters.theme: Polymarket proxy shorts from rich/heatmap signals
failureClusters.evidence: funding_extreme_long_pm_proxy_short is 3/19 (16%, avg -2.67%), pc_ratio_extreme_low_pm_proxy_short is 1/15 (7%, avg -4.87%), and relative_value_heatmap is 4/15 (27%, avg -8.09%).
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not promote proxy-short variants based only on spot/funding/heatmap richness. They need direct PM edge, tight spread, and liquidity gates or should be retired.

failureClusters.theme: Unrestricted one-touch NO edge without gating
failureClusters.evidence: Broad ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO shadows are 102/268 (38.1%, avg -0.85%), while the gated upside-barrier FIND-0020 subset is 51/82 (62.2%, avg +5.75%).
failureClusters.recommendation: Always require upside barrier, edge >= 3pt, tight spread, and exit on edge decay. Do not use broad one-touch edge alone.

newHypotheses.description: Short GOLD spot when GLD put/call ratio is in the bottom 10% of its 7-day range while spot is still above its 24h SMA. This captures extremely crowded call-buying versus a still-positive short-term trend, a setup that was previously blocked but won in shadow mining.
newHypotheses.prediction: GOLD spot will fall more than 2% within 3 days.

newHypotheses.prediction: The YES premium on BTC above-strike one-touch contracts decays within 3 days without spot making the barrier.

newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS spot will move more than 2% within 2 days as funding normalizes from an already-starting reversion.

newHypotheses.prediction: GOLD spot will decline more than 2% within 2 days when rich one-touch NO edge aligns with short-term spot weakness.

newHypotheses.prediction: GOLD spot will decline more than 2% within 2 days when the no-bias gap is extreme and spot has already turned lower.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-567: only take the near-expiry GOLD upside one-touch NO short when gold spot is below its 24h SMA and 24h spot change is negative. This prevents the repeated failure of shorting rich upside YES premium into strong gold up-moves.
newHypotheses.prediction: GOLD spot will decline more than 2% within 2 days when near-expiry one-touch NO edge aligns with short-term spot weakness.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-108: keep HYPE risk-on confirmation but also require BTC itself to have positive 24h price change and be close to the 7-day high. This avoids the failure where HYPE conditions held while BTC was already rolling over.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot will rise more than 2% within 3 days when HYPE confirmation is joined by positive BTC 24h momentum.

hypothesisReviews.observation: CBRS < -10% did not reliably normalize in 2 days. Loss examples include funding falling from -8.1% to -162.1% and from 5.5% to -67.0%, while wins came only when reversion had already started (e.g. -67.0% to 2.3%). The entry was catching falling funding rather than a reversion.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A standalone CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and forces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: HYPE risk-on confirmation repeatedly triggered near local BTC tops. Loss examples show BTC falling 1.69% to 3.47% while HYPE above-SMA/stable-OI conditions remained true, meaning HYPE participation was not a continuation signal.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above SMA with stable OI confirms a >2% BTC long move over 3-7 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 0/20 scorable. Gold rallied against the short in the most damaging cases (+5.37%, +3.97%, +7.35%, +8.74%), showing the upside YES premium reflected real bullish drift rather than a rich quote to fade.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying-cap edge on gold upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Gold P/C collapse with PM settlement EV > 4800 did not predict spot rally toward PM levels. Spot failed to converge and shorts were repeatedly caught by small up moves or failed to reach -2%, suggesting the PM settlement premium persisted instead of forcing spot.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Gold P/C ratio collapse below 0.65 with PM settlement EV above spot predicts spot rally toward PM levels within 7 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 0/15 scorable. The large no-bias gap was not a mispriced premium; it often stayed rich as gold held a bid. Most losses showed gold up 0.18% to 0.92%, with only one -1.11% move, never the required -2%.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large no-bias adjusted gap on rich GOLD tail NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Near-expiry did not save the GOLD upside one-touch short. Spot rallied strongly after entries (+6.71%, +8.74%, +7.35%) before any meaningful premium decay could help, indicating the edge was a trend premium rather than time decay.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Rich near-expiry GOLD upside one-touch YES premium decays predictably enough to sell short.

journalEntry: Tonight's focus was killing or heavily gating the gold/PM-rich up-fade family and the HYPE/BTC confirmation family. Gold upside NO/no-bias and near-expiry rich shorts all failed because they fought a persistent bid; refinements now require spot below the 24h SMA and negative 24h change, which changes the mechanism from unconditional fade to trend-aligned fade. CBRS funding reversion was refined to require an already-started funding reversion and true weekend context. New FIND-sourced hypotheses focus on tight-spread, liquid, gated one-touch NO edges and smart-flow fade rather than broad heatmap/proxy richness. No parameter updates were made because the clean evidence favors changing entry mechanisms and gates rather than risk-level tuning.
